body:
Sub-tasks (approved plan):
S1 (server, complex). New src/chrome/install-scan.js: scanForInstallId finds which profile's Local Extension Settings/<extensionId>/ LevelDB files contain the installId (validated extensionId ^[a-p]{32}$ and UUID installId; read-only; *.log/*.ldb only; 8MB/file, 32MB total; skip symlinks; tolerate locked/missing files; count profiles not occurrences; log counts only). resolveHelloProfile step 2b (after gaiaEmail, before inference by exclusion) via deps.scanInstallProfile; accept exactly one match; 30s negative cache per installId. hello gains extensionId.
S2 (server, standard). pendingIdentification set (add on identify_required send; delete on hello_ack, close, 4409); /api/ui/status exposes pendingIdentification.count; buildKnownProfiles() adds connected/registered flags to identify_required (registered via extensionInstalls.loadInstalls, shared with the status route); broadcast identification_pending_changed.
S3 (extension, standard). hello sends extensionId; background handles {type:'reidentify', profileId} as the ONLY writer of webpilot.profileId (validate against knownProfiles, await storage.set, resetIdentifyState, send hello if OPEN else clearReconnectSchedule + reconnect, honoring enabled/manuallyDisconnected); background mirrors connection status/errorType to chrome.storage.session; popup: on 401 render a picker from webpilot.knownProfiles (suggested = !connected && !registered first; connected rows marked in use; storage.onChanged re-renders), pick → reidentify → poll /api/popup/state; connection_in_use shows a clear message and keeps the picker usable; new actionable 401 copy; remove stale picker comments.
S4 (web UI, light). profiles page + Set up modal: when pendingIdentification.count > 0 show 'Extension detected — open the WebPilot popup in this profile to finish'; subscribe both pages to identification_pending_changed.
S5 (docs, last). CHROME_EXTENSION.md, MCP_SERVER.md, security doc resolution order + filesystem-read note, CHANGELOG.
Tests: install-scan.test.js (mkdtemp fixtures), hello-profile.test.js ordering, pending-set lifecycle, buildKnownProfiles flags; extension/web UI: node --check + manual checklist.
